title: Kingston airport: 3 ways to your hotel

lines.text: Landing in Kingston? Here are three ways to get to your hotel.
The airport sits on the Palisadoes peninsula beside the harbour, about twenty minutes from downtown Kingston.
One: a pre-booked private transfer, so your driver is arranged before you land.
Two: an approved taxi. The UK advises Jamaican Tourist Board taxis with a blue JTB sticker.
Three: a rental car. Jamaica drives on the left.
